methodology.missing: null with n=0; observed zero or empty event log has n=1
methodology.samples: n counts matches with an observed value, not events or timeline points
methodology.full_replay: Parsed flag plus aligned gold/xp/lh/denies/net-worth timelines, purchase/kill/death/buyback logs, lane positions, lane efficiency, participation, objectives and teamfights. Does not imply every possible field exists.
methodology.timelines: Pairs of [seconds,value]. gold_t is cumulative gold, never a net-worth substitute. Exact 10/20/30-minute samples only; shorter matches excluded.
methodology.kda: (kills+assists)/deaths; ratio unavailable when deaths=0, raw K/D/A retained
methodology.purchase_samples: First-purchase timing means include only games with an observed purchase; no purchase is not a zero timing.
methodology.events: Objectives and Roshan/Aegis are match-wide events, not automatically player credit. Item log times describe purchases, not guaranteed item completion.
methodology.positioning: OpenDota lane_pos and ward heatmaps only; not a full movement trace.
methodology.interpretation: Descriptive correlations only. Win/loss differences do not prove mistakes or causal effects; hero, role, patch, duration and selection bias are not controlled.
methodology.units: Duration and event times in seconds; participation fraction; lane_efficiency_pct percent; other scalar units follow OpenDota field names.
